Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, positive leukocyte esterase, and >100,000 CFU/mL Pseudomonas aeruginosa, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy guided by sensitivity testing.
